meta.title: Baltimore MedTech live data workbook
meta.description: One spreadsheet-style page per source, with live queries for public APIs and explicit repository-snapshot labels for curated local datasets.
meta.live_definition: Live means the page queries the publisher or its release metadata through the MedTech Worker when opened. Repository snapshots remain versioned inputs and are never labeled live.
meta.privacy_note: The workbook exposes public aggregate and provider-directory data only. It does not retrieve patient-level records or restricted claims files.

datasets.title: Baltimore MedTech Medical Taxonomy
datasets.description: Spreadsheet view of the existing polyhierarchical medical-field index, including scientific lineage, anatomy, methods, scale, population, translation, and tags.
limitations: This is a curated orientation taxonomy, not an official clinical terminology or licensing classification.

datasets.title: Clinical and Administrative Code Systems
datasets.description: Spreadsheet view of ICD, CPT, HCPCS, NDC, place-of-service, revenue, and Medicaid-related coding layers already used by the Medical Atlas.
limitations: Descriptions are educational orientation; implementation requires current code sets, licenses, manuals, and payer rules.

datasets.title: Clinical Semantic and Interoperability Systems
datasets.description: Spreadsheet view of SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, FHIR, UMLS, DICOM, GA4GH VRS, and OMOP CDM roles and official stewardship links.
limitations: Mappings are contextual and version-dependent; this index does not distribute licensed terminology content.

datasets.title: MedTech Strategy Field Metrics
datasets.publisher: Baltimore MedTech from cited public sources
datasets.coverage: Four example fields; source years vary
datasets.description: One row per example field combining existing workforce, entrant-pipeline, need, lead NIH institute funding, digital leverage, and strategy annotations.
limitations: Field measures use different definitions and years and are not a universal ranking of medical importance.

datasets.title: Need–Availability Distortion Metrics
datasets.coverage: Four example fields; source years vary
datasets.description: Auditable row-level view of the current need-per-physician pressure, pipeline fragility, availability composite, signed gap, and distortion index.
limitations: The index is relative within four unlike need proxies and is not an absolute shortage threshold or access rate.

datasets.title: Selected Allied Care-Team Employment and Openings
datasets.publisher: Baltimore MedTech from BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook
datasets.description: One row per selected allied occupation, preserving its field mapping, SOC code, employment, annual openings, mapping strength, source, and scope warning.
limitations: Mapped occupations are not dedicated specialty full-time equivalents and do not exhaust the full care team.
